name: Bee Yard Wingman
notes: 🔢 Hives tab: every hive and queen button shows how many hives it has, under bold Hive Status and Queen Status headings.
👑 A new hive added with a queen counts as Queen Right, and picking a queen status in Edit counts too.
✂️ Splits: say the whole plan at once ("leave the queen in hive 6, the new hive raises its own"), and the side without the queen either raises one or gets one put in, today or later.
✂️ + Add Hive, Came from Split: asks which one has the queen and updates both hives.
🍯 Winter stores: in an inspection, count the honey frames by how full they are for an estimate in pounds, and the target for your area. Set your own frame weights and target in Settings.
